result:
**Verdict: PASS.** I raised no new findings, and my open finding F-DG5-100 is now closed and verified. This is an engineering review of the frozen DG5 candidate; it is not a business, Finance or IT approval.

**Candidate.** The ID `sha256:55a411ae…a3a24ce` (2207 files, source `660f40c`) matches on a complete clone. HEAD `7a02e7d` is its freeze commit and adds only delivery records. During my run, HEAD moved to `550d3bd`: the domain reviewer's run was auto-committed (delivery files only). The candidate ID is unchanged, and I did not open that record.

**F-DG5-100 (Medium, DOCX/PPTX not well-formed with control characters): closed and verified.**
- **Code.** Every text that reaches a DOCX or PPTX file now has invalid characters replaced with U+FFFD. Every OOXML file is also checked before it is stored, so a bad file fails the job instead of being saved as succeeded.
- **End to end.** I renamed the transformation and added a RAID entry, both containing control characters. Every DOCX, PPTX and XLSX export succeeded in English and Arabic and was well-formed, with U+FFFD in place and the stored text unchanged.
- **Renderer.** All forbidden characters, in four positions, give 24 of 24 well-formed files, from both the built and the source code.
- **Mutants.** Every one was killed:
  - With the old writers, the jobs report success but the files contain raw control characters. This reproduces the round-1 defect.
  - With only the file check left in place, the job fails with `export.render_failed` and nothing is stored.

**Required checks.** All ran and passed:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build, typecheck, lint, format, OpenAPI lint (846 operations), no-CDN | exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, Node 22 and Node 24 | 2366 + 1746 + 259 tests, 2 skipped by design |
| Integration, LANG unset and LANG=C.UTF-8 | 321/321 files and 3087 tests each, 1 skipped by design; 89 migrations 0001→0097; contract test 83/83 |
| Gate validators (`--historical` DG4/DG3/DG2/DG1, `--register DG5`, `--pipeline`) | all pass |
| Role sweep (AUD and admin-only callers) | 9/9: 0 of 90 writes succeeded per role, no table changed |
| Data-exposure checks | admin-only callers see nothing transformation-scoped; export downloads are requester-only (404 for others) |
| Database probes | 0096 refuses every other change of a step's transformation; every trigger is enabled after 0094 |

The outbox, lock-registry, commit-time, module-graph, contract and secrets scans were also clean.

**Failures and retries in my logs, all explained in the record:**
- **Node 22 unit run.** It exited 1 because of one Vitest internal timeout under machine load of about 25 on 4 CPUs. No test failed. I re-ran that project alone and it passed cleanly; both runs are reported.
- **Static-step wrapper.** It exited 2 because I edited the script while it was running. All six steps had already logged exit 0.
- **Two of my own probe attempts.** One requested a format the charter does not offer. The other failed because `rsync` is not installed, which my control check caught. Both were fixed and re-run.

**Observations (not findings):**
- Starter automations and Studio settings are shared across all organizations by design.
- The forms CSV export keeps its own copy of the formula-injection trigger list, with the same behaviour as the shared one.
- The web entry chunk is 1.59 MB, a performance item for DG6.

The records are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-2/`:
- `code-security-reviewer.json` (validated against the review schema)
- `code-security-reviewer.verifications.json`

The evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/code-security/round-2/`. All disposable clones have been removed.
